dedupe_keys.name: bornes de recharge pour vehicules electriques sur le departement du cher

description: Bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques sur le département du Cher is a dataset listed in BourgesPlus OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by data.gouv.fr. Fichier consolidé des Bornes de Recharge pour Véhicules Electriques (IRVE) restreint sur le département du Cher. (V2.3.1) Fichier de données source: Documentation de la structure des données: schema.data.gouv.fr. Coverage: Bourges Plus (Cher). The portal files it under Environnement, Mobilités. Its keywords are IRVE, Borne, recharge, electrique. The portal shows 804 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bourgesplus-fr-portal.
